mapper.insert: MERGE INTO fx_rate f USING (SELECT #{countryId} AS country_id, #{baseDate} AS base_date FROM dual) s ON (f.country_id = s.country_id AND f.base_date = s.base_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET f.deal_bas_r = #{dealBasR}, f.currency = #{currency} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (country_id, currency, deal_bas_r, base_date) VALUES (#{countryId}, #{currency}, #{dealBasR}, #{baseDate})
INSERT INTO fx_rate (country_id, currency, deal_bas_r, base_date) VALUES (#{countryId}, #{currency}, #{dealBasR}, #{baseDate})
mapper.select: SELECT fx_rate_id AS fxRateId, country_id AS countryId, currency, deal_bas_r AS dealBasR, base_date AS baseDate FROM fx_rate WHERE country_id = #{countryId} AND base_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7 ORDER BY base_date ASC
